subject: Kickoff: ACT clarification-turn service
body:
Team,

Starting the ACT workstream. Our open-source Learning to Clarify release showed that Action-Based Contrastive Self-Training gets a model to decide between answering and asking a clarifying question in multi-turn conversations. The product angle for data-platforms: package that as a service any assistant team can fine-tune against their own dialogs, instead of every team hand-labeling ambiguity.

Rough milestones inside our window:
- Mar 13: containerized pipeline running end to end on the PACIFIC example (convert_pacific.py for train and validation splits, 20-entry smoke sample first).
- Apr 10: full PACIFIC training run plus eval report.
- May 15: internal alpha with one partner team.

Bruno will follow up on staffing and the compute ask. Please flag dataset licensing questions early — PACIFIC is external.

Dmitri
